items.text: The question sounds like it needs a single winner.

items.heading: If You Already Know
items.text: If you already know you want engineering, architecture, or a deep technical career and can genuinely handle the Physics-Chemistry-Maths depth, JEE is the only route to IITs, NITs, and IIITs, there is no CUET equivalent for that specific outcome.

items.heading: Get Honest About Your Pcm
items.text: Get honest about your PCM foundation. Attempt one real past JEE Main paper under timed conditions. A weak, guess-heavy attempt is useful data, not a failure, it tells you how far the gap actually is before you commit two years to closing it.

items.heading: Map Your Actual Interest, Not
items.text: Map your actual interest, not your family's. List the three subjects or types of work you enjoy most, independent of what "sounds impressive." Compare that list honestly against engineering coursework versus a CUET-linked degree's coursework.

items.heading: Run the Real Cost Conversation
items.text: Run the real cost conversation. Sit down with your family and put an actual number on JEE coaching (₹4-12 lakh over two years, or ₹1.5-4 lakh online) against CUET preparation (largely covered by board-exam study, plus a ₹1000 exam fee). Decide if that gap changes anything.

items.heading: Run the Four Questions
items.text: Run the four questions on your top choice. Score yourself honestly on your fit, your situation, the job market and AI-proofing for whichever exam you are leaning toward.
